title: model
description: The operating model itself: its name, purpose and the key messages everyone should take away. Exactly one per folder, in model.md at the top of the folder.

id.description: Unique id: lower-case letters and numbers joined by hyphens, e.g. acme-sample. Also used as the snapshot file name.

purpose.description: Why this operating model exists. Markdown is allowed.

key_messages.description: The shared conclusions every viewer should reach, in order.

version.description: Optional content version, shown in the snapshot footer.

status.description: How this element differs from today.

today.description: How it works today, shown next to the future state.
